first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Execute ordered Throwable suppression from the selected JDK (verification pending)
commits.body:
Run addSuppressed and getSuppressed on the actual exception in both native checking and interpreted replay. The selected image supplies self and null validation, the empty singleton, and the order of appends. The private list retains reference identities and returns detached nonempty arrays. Recognize forwarding four-argument Throwable constructors, keep symbolic suppression flags and distinguish an explicit NullPointerException message from VM-generated stack details.

The direct Java fixture and both engines agreed on enabled and disabled suppression, duplicate entries, aliasing, private-field hiding, detached arrays, and the message and cause of invalid arguments on Temurin 21.0.13 and 25.0.5. The changed test run passed after its independent encoding-time test passed on retry, and the Rust tier inventory lint passed. Job 20261120-061145-verify-ordered-resource-failures-with-th checks all nine original obligations of example 322 with fresh JVM witness replay.

commits.summary: Follow reachable constructors of static object constants (verification pending)
commits.body:
Strict checking executes the real bytecode of straight-line initializers that assemble final object or array constants with application methods. The checker follows the constructors at the values actually passed, including reachable exceptions and erroneous-class reuse. An unsupported call reached by a constructor still stops the proof. Existing observed initializers and advised contracts retain their handling.

The direct JVM and native controls checked two distinct constants and the first and second use of a class whose constructor throws. A reachable Double.parseDouble stayed open while the same unreachable call did not impede either proof. Changed tests passed. A capped probe on the original Commons Math JARs proved the fixed raw percentage and independently replayed parent input 8. Jobs 20261120-061640-prove-fraction-percentages-through-the-o and 20261120-061640-recheck-partial-dates-through-their-actu run all sixteen original Fraction and MonthDay obligations.

commits.summary: Prove bounded regex captures and signed-long parsing (verification pending)
commits.body:
Preserve capture numbering, the previous match outcome and the original String on each matcher. A mandatory capture is observed when its UTF-16 endpoints follow from fixed widths on the matched input. Optional, repeated and ambiguous spans retain an explicit refusal. Share one overflow-before-multiply decimal parser between int and long, including their negative minima and signed zero. Non-ASCII digits keep the JDK gap.

Native and JVM controls covered nested captures, invalid group numbers before and after matching, whole-string identity, both long limits and out-of-range texts. The ambiguous and optional controls are true on the JVM and stayed open natively. An incorrect group claim was refuted. Changed tests passed after one UTF-16 test passed on retry. A capped probe proved the frozen fixed ThreeTen round trip at unwind 24. Job 20261120-062318-verify-canonical-signed-tai-texts-and-in checks all six original claims on the 20 canonical inputs per upstream revision.

commits.summary: Record native TAI, resource closure and Fraction results
commits.body:
The shared runner decided all six ThreeTen claims, all nine resource-observer claims, and all six historical Fraction claims on the frozen domains. Their strict native witnesses replayed on the JDK and matched the independent observation grids. All ten MonthDay claims advanced from class initialization to list use in the formatter and remain open on this checker.

The four result trees and every applied receipt were byte-checked against the collector. Audited each source claim, bounds, ordered classpath, input grid and native witness. The four example folders and pipeline records passed validation.

commits.summary: Execute bounded ArrayList operations from the runtime image (verification pending)
commits.body:
Use the selected JDK bytecode for a constructed ArrayList's growth, membership, indexed reads and writes, and typed array copies. The checker qualifies the private empty arrays and the actual runtime array class. Copying a typed destination preserves a successful prefix on failure in both engines. Model selection stays explicit. Object arrays can hold array components of other ranks as Java allows. Stream.of(T...) uses the existing sequential array stream and runs the application's predicate. Decimal Long.toString uses the signed conversion path when the image returns fresh Strings.

JVM and native controls passed on Temurin 21 and 25 for capacity growth, nulls, identity, oversized buffers, detached typed arrays, partial stores, nested array types, stream short-circuiting and decimal formatting. The updated native conformance corpus passed in isolation and the changed test selection passed. A fresh proof now establishes the existing guarded copy of a mutable list. A single strict probe also proved the fixed duration lexer on its original domain. Joda-Time advanced to the system property selecting its zone provider.

Jobs 20261120-063346-verify-both-historical-duration-tokenize and 20261120-063346-verify-partial-dates-past-the-shared-lis check the two historical consumers. Jobs 20261120-063346-recheck-ordered-resource-failures-on-sha, 20261120-063346-recheck-all-signed-tai-observations-on-t and 20261120-063347-repeat-fraction-overflow-checks-on-the-s repeat the other three affected packets. Jobs 20261120-063347-recheck-both-array-roots-after-typed-lis and 20261120-063347-recheck-the-released-lcs-score-after-typ verify the two original regressions. Jobs 20261120-063726-compare-bounded-arraylist-claims-across and 20261120-063726-confirm-jvm-corpus-verdicts-after-select cover the full JBMC, automatic and confirmation comparisons.

commits.summary: Record the duration, partial-date and list regression runs
commits.body:
The selected JDK list methods preserved every ThreeTen, resource-closure and Fraction verdict. The duration checker refuted the historical separated-field claim and proved the fixed text and quoting observations. Three original claims stopped at Arrays.fill(char[],char). All ten MonthDay checks reached the ambient time-zone provider property. Keep both failed jobs and their partial results.

All seven result trees and their applied receipts matched the collector byte for byte. The 71-heap array-root regression retained both replayed witnesses. The released LCS score was proved in 0.740 seconds and 80.3 MiB at the original bounds; the release and source agreed with all 225 JVM cases and the shared-row control differed on 44. The source-claim audit and pipeline schema check passed.

commits.summary: Check UTF-16 padding through char array fill and String.concat (verification pending)
commits.body:
The three remaining Commons Lang duration observations reached Arrays.fill(char[],char). Execute its selected JDK loop, snapshot the char array in the constructed String, and execute String.concat with its empty-suffix identity and fresh UTF-16 result. The interpreter follows the same fill and preserves the receiver on empty concatenation. The method conformance inventory records normal and null cases.

The JVM, native checker and interpreter agree on null arguments, empty arrays, isolated surrogates, a later mutation to the source array and both String identities on Temurin 21 and 25. A changed-padding control was refuted. The method evidence samples passed, the changed test selection passed after the new evidence record was supplied, and capped original-scope probes proved fixed adjacent fields and parent quoting. Job 20261120-065325-verify-raw-duration-patterns-through-utf rechecks all six duration claims. Jobs 20261120-065325-confirm-shared-array-poststates-after-ch and 20261120-065325-confirm-commons-text-lcs-after-character repeat the original 197 and 308 regressions on the finished checker.

commits.summary: Record 91 native decisions on the Java fast-follow examples
commits.body:
The strict native checker now establishes 66 and refutes 25 of the 125 original source claim and subject pairs, with 34 open. This continuation added 19 proofs and five independently replayed refutations. All native observations for ThreeTen signed seconds, resource closure, Commons Lang duration tokens and Commons Math fractions agree with their original JVM grids. The ten Joda-Time native claims reach the JDK property that selects the default zone provider. The complete independent finite register remains 92 established and 33 refuted, with no contradictions or withdrawals.

On the finished checker the 71-heap regression retained its return proof and both independently replayed poststate violations. The released Commons Text LCS score proved in 0.639 s at 79.1 MiB, using array bound 4 and unwind 18. The release and source matched all 225 pairs and the shared-row control differed 44 times. Both JBMC/automatic and automatic-confirmation corpus jobs passed. All 16 new jobs were collected: 13 passed, three preserve the earlier duration padding or Joda-Time diagnostics.

Audited all 125 claim identities and finite hashes, native verdicts and witness qualification, original bounds, ordered classpaths and selected JDK. All 444 result files for these jobs matched the collector byte for byte, and all 336 campaign report links resolved. The seven affected and regression examples validated, the pipeline schema check found no errors, and the complete default suite passed all 61 groups on tree 91a71c0d9730.
